name: DataFeel (datafeel.com)
note: Early account named by Torian (t26u). Relationship: customer (target customer; Torian, t27u, relayed; nothing sold, so still a prospect). See decisions/datafeel-role. Public facts, each with its raw source: WHAT: B2B company commercializing patented multi-energy haptics; the DataFeel Dot delivers vibration, heat, cold and light to the skin, with composer software and an API; sold as a Dev Kit, licensed, and co-developed with partners (raw/sources/datafeel-home, datafeel-about, datafeel-partner). Also developing two own consumer devices, a wrist wearable and a child-wellness companion, under separate brands (raw/sources/datafeel-integration). IP: 14 US, 3 EU, 3 CA, 2 KR, 2 PCT filings listed (raw/sources/datafeel-patents); self-reported $1,000,000+ IP licensing revenue to date (raw/sources/datafeel-home). STAGE: Gen 10 Dev Kit production wrapped; Gen 11 Dev Kit preorder expected Q1 2027 at an expected $750 (raw/sources/datafeel-shop). Seed rounds Nov 2020 $275k, Oct 2021 $570k, Nov 2023 $170k, Sep 2024 undisclosed (third-party, raw/sources/dealroom-datafeel). HQ: Omaha, Nebraska per Dealroom (third-party); the company says 'North America based' (raw/sources/datafeel-about). SIZE: 2-10 people per Dealroom (third-party). CUSTOMERS: null. The home page lists Hyperice, REVO, Casio, HTC and universities as partners and research collaborators, but the page itself labels them placeholder text pending approval, so they are not treated as verified. LEADERSHIP (company page): Matthew Leaper, Co-Founder/CEO (raw/sources/datafeel-about). Fuller fields with nulls: interim/accounts/datafeel/profile.json (GAPS.md G-22).
